title: Fuzzy Biker Moto
author: Fuzzy Biker Moto
description: I am a motorcycle rider clocking between 45,000 to 65,000 miles per year. Love all vintage and classic motorcycles &  ride as many as possible. ADV motorcycles are my favorite and I do travel all over the Americas. Riding over 100,000 km in about 14 months on my Royal Enfield Himalayan 450. Riding10,000 mile ride across Canada to Alaska and the Arctic Circle. I'm particularly interested in the American SW and all our desert areas, mountains & amazing national parks.
